name: Okano Takahiro
source:
"It's OK if you call me Senpai."

[url=/c46273]Haruomi's[/url] friend and [url=/c46276]Rino's[/url] boyfriend.
He's the president of the movie club, but he doesn't really care about movies that much. His hobby is making candy.
